title: Volcanoes for kids
examples: What is the difference between magma and lava?

explain.say: A volcano is like a big mountain with a hole at the top. Hot stuff inside pushes things out.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: inside a volcano. Can you see the ash cloud and the crater? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Deep inside the Earth, hot melted rock is called magma. This magma is under the ground.
When magma reaches the surface, it changes name and becomes lava. Lava flows out onto the ground.
An eruption is when the volcano suddenly pushes out its stuff. This can be lava or ash.
Volcanoes also send out fine bits of rock called ash. Ash can cover a large area.

items: It flies high in the air

explain.say: Think about a fizzy drink. The built-up fizz is like the pressure inside a volcano.

faq.q: What is the difference between magma and lava?
faq.a: Magma is the melted rock found deep inside the Earth. Lava is what the magma becomes once it flows out onto the surface.

faq.q: What causes a volcano to erupt?
faq.a: A volcano erupts because the pressure from the trapped melted rock, the magma, gets too strong. This force pushes everything out.
asks: What makes the volcano go boom?

faq.q: Is the ash from a volcano dangerous?
faq.a: Yes, volcanic ash can be dangerous because it can cover things and make breathing hard. It is made of tiny bits of rock.
asks: What is volcanic ash made of?

faq.q: Do all volcanoes erupt the same way?
faq.a: No, volcanoes can erupt in many different ways. Some might flow slowly with lava, while others might send out ash very high.
asks: What kinds of eruptions are there?

faq.a: Lava can flow over the land, but it cools down and hardens over time. When it cools, it becomes solid rock.

facts: Magma is found beneath the Earth's surface.
Lava is molten rock that flows from a volcano.
Ash is made of tiny fragments of rock and glass.
Volcanic eruptions are caused by building pressure.

quiz.say: What is the melted rock found deep inside the Earth called?
quiz.why: Magma is the correct term for melted rock found underground.

wrong.1: Lava is what the rock becomes when it reaches the surface.
wrong.2: Ash is the fine powder that flies out, not the liquid rock.
wrong.3: Eruption is the action of coming out, not the substance itself.

quiz.say: When magma reaches the surface, it becomes:
quiz.why: When the melted rock leaves the ground, it is called lava.

wrong.0: Rock is what it becomes later, but the flowing liquid is lava.
wrong.2: Magma stays underground; it changes name when it flows out.
wrong.3: Ash is only the powder, not the flowing liquid.

quiz.say: The sudden release of gas and melted rock is called:
quiz.why: Eruption describes the whole event when the volcano pushes stuff out.

wrong.0: Ash is just one type of material that can come out.
wrong.2: Magma is the material inside, not the event itself.
wrong.3: Lava is the material that flows out, not the action.
